steps.title: Grow culture overnight
steps.instruction: Grow 50 mL YPD culture overnight (≈16 h) with shaking at 30 °C.

steps.title: Pellet and wash cells
steps.instruction: Pellet cells in a tabletop centrifuge using a 50 mL disposable tube; optionally wash the pellet with water and repeat centrifugation.

steps.title: Freeze and lyophilize cells
steps.instruction: Freeze the cell pellet at –20 °C to –80 °C for less than 30 min, then dry it in a freeze‑drying machine.

steps.title: Add glass beads and grind
steps.instruction: Add 3–5 mL of 2 mm glass beads to the frozen pellet and vortex/shake until the cells are broken and a fine powder forms.

steps.title: Add CTAB extraction buffer
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 10 mL CTAB extraction buffer to the powdered sample and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Add chloroform and mix
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, add 10 mL chloroform to the mixture and gently mix for approximately 1 minute.

steps.title: Centrifuge extraction mixture
steps.instruction: Spin the tube in a tabletop centrifuge for 10 minutes at 2,500–3,000 rpm.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the ~7 mL aqueous supernatant to a 15 mL disposable tube, add an equal volume of isopropanol, and gently rock back and forth to mix.

steps.title: Recover DNA pellet
steps.instruction: If DNA forms strands or clumps, spool them with a glass pipette into an Eppendorf tube containing 1 mL 70 % ethanol; otherwise, centrifuge for 10 minutes, discard supernatant, wash the pellet with 1 mL 70 % ethanol, and transfer to an Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and dry
steps.instruction: Spin the tube in a microcentrifuge for 5–10 minutes, remove the ethanol, and allow the pellet to air‑dry.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA and assess
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried DNA in ~500 µL water or TE buffer; optionally add RNase to a final concentration of 20 µg/mL; load 1 µL on an agarose gel to evaluate concentration and quality.

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the resuspended DNA at 65 °C for 30 minutes.
